messages:
Nina Roberts: Quick follow-up from the postmortem two canary misses. Need owners + short timelines for safety fixes.
Leo Kim: I'll take auto-rollback. Plan: rules engine that evaluates error-rate + p95 + user-error signatures, calls pause-rollout API. Prototype by Fri.
Harpreet Singh: I'll own flag schema + blast-radius caps. Proposal: require `max_blast_radius` on creation and server-side lint to block missing field. Draft PR by Thu.
Maya Lopez: Ill handle telemetry + recurring-pattern detection. I'll add daily canary anomaly job and a dashboard; backfill 30 days for baselines.
Nina Roberts: Good. Please post PR links here. Also adding a 6-week weekly 30m follow-up to track progress.
ci-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Rollout safety follow-ups" weekly Wed 09:30 for 6 weeks.
Leo Kim: Implementation detail: rollback action should be idempotent and emit audit events, not flip flags directly.
Harpreet Singh: Suggested flag snippet for new flags: `max_blast_radius: 0.02`, `initial_fraction: 0.01`, `ramp_policy: [0.01,0.05,0.25,1.0]`. Will include in PR.
Maya Lopez: Saved queries planned: `canary_error_spike` (5x baseline in 10m) and `p95_shift` (40% sustained). Alerts routed to #eng-oncall + owner.
Nina Roberts: Ownership matrix for postmortem doc: Leo -> rollback, Harpreet -> flags, Maya -> telemetry, Nina -> docs & follow-ups. Target: prototypes this week, tests next.
Leo Kim: Draft PR for rollback prototype: https://git.redwood/ri/guardrails/pulls/311 (WIP).
Harpreet Singh: Draft PR for flag schema + lint: https://git.redwood/ri/flags/pulls/89 (WIP).
Maya Lopez: Will post dashboards in #eng-observability and ping here when live.
Nina Roberts: Final: rotate remediation owners monthly to keep recurring patterns owned. React :thumbsup: when your first PR is up.
Leo Kim: Done.
Harpreet Singh: Done.
Maya Lopez: Done.
Nina Roberts: Thanks everyone, closing thread.
